name: Greifswald (Germany)
description: White field with two narrow red stripes near the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the red griffin of the city arms of Greifswald.
history: Municipal flag of Greifswald; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: two narrow red stripes near the top edge
